scope: Theorem 1.2 (Global maximal AH Penrose inequality) of the manuscript “The Penrose inequality for maximal asymptotically hyperbolic initial data” (preprints/The-Penrose-inequality-for-maximal-asymptotically-hyperbolic-initial-data-October-5-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 260 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 641d4aa3892adbca), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 3. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Under (1.2)–(1.8), the completeness, one-end, and smoothness assumptions above, and the future-timelike condition (1.5), one has mAH(g) ≥ 1 2 (︁ rA + r3 A )︁ , rA = √︄ Amin(S; g) 4π . (1.10) The coefficient is sharp: equality holds for every positive-mass time-symmetric Schwarzschild–anti- de Sitter exterior bounded by its minimal horizon.
